reviews.review:
9/10 - This is close to a perfect game but is held back by a rushed final DLC and PC performance/stability issues. A souls-like shooter that will feel at home for anyone familiar with the Souls-series, although not required to enjoy. If you're a fan of the Monster Hunter series, you'll enjoy the flexibility of build options you get between the different archetype and item combinations. There are secrets in this game that can be very creative or very obtuse depending on your viewpoint, but a pain for someone trying to collect every item.

Some tips:
* Handler is a good generalist archetype that pairs well with almost everything, and starts with two very strong weapons - if you're not sure what class to start with as your first.
* Co-op WITH FRIENDS is where the game shines most (public matchmaing is not great).
* When you get to the final boss, if you're struggling with cues, turn the in-game music off and listen to the sound cues.

Good:
+ The build flexibility in the game is unmatched, if you're the type of person that likes to tweak builds, you will have so much to do in this game.
+ The gameplay is very sharp and feels great. It doesn't take long to get used to and just using different weapons provides a fun experience.
+ Some of the most innovative and fun boss fights in a souls-like game (personal callouts are Annihilation, Venom, Nightweaver, and One True King)
+ Great visuals, OST and sound effects.
+ Boss rush is a good way to get into the action for someone less interested in looping through campaigns and get material.

Bad:
- Issues with performance and stability. I use an Intel i7-13700K and have to use Intel Extreme Tuning Utility to underclock my processor to prevent crashes.
- Issues with matchmaking and communication in public servers online. Suggest either going to the Remnant 2 Discord or Reddit and finding people you can communicate with.
- Boss rush is fun, but doesn't save progress for long gauntlets, meaning a kick or disconnect can lose an hour of progress.
- Some bad bosses you'll be fighting regularly (Legion, Bloat King)
- The prism system as an endgame grind is rough for someone looking to build a perfect prism to supplement your build, as it provides a lot of RNG.

REALLY FUN! But also kinda super disappointing.

This game kind of ends up eating itself in all the hype.

6.8/10
